allow: PowerShell(\(Get-Command godot -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)?.Source; Get-ChildItem "D:\\" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)

hooks.command: plans_dir="$HOME/.claude/plans"; latest=$(ls -t "$plans_dir"/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$latest" ] && [ -n "$repo_root" ]; then mkdir -p "$repo_root/Docs/Plans/inbox"; dest="$repo_root/Docs/Plans/inbox/$(basename "$latest")"; cp "$latest" "$dest"; git -C "$repo_root" add "$dest" 2>/dev/null; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Copied plan $(basename "$latest") into Docs/Plans/inbox/ and staged it (uncommitted).\"}"; fi; true
